scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Affine unoriented zero-thickness planes only; not a positive-thickness slab, straight-track or central-section theorem. Arbitrary compact convex planar bases with interior. Circular base formula is prior work. Absolute priority against unindexed older stereology is not certified; numerical experiments are corroborative and do not establish universal quantifiers.
title: Sharp cap-incidence probability for all convex cylinders and constant-width extremizers
